notes.title: The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION - The UpdaTUX
SPRING RENOVATION UPDATE
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/d91c4bb1b51e06ecd762da45d5c2ca9194a4e3ff.png

Hello!

The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION has been released. It is now time to give some love to the Free Edition as well! The previous version was two years old: with the Spring Renovation Update this small fragment of the full game will look like the one in the DEFINITIVE EDITION.
In addition you can now play the game in three new languages: French, German and Russian. 

If you have played the Free Edition before and you are still waiting to play the DEFINITIVE EDITION, we suggest you play the game again and experience all the improvements made in the past two years.

Thanks for your support, we hope to see you again in the DEFINITIVE EDITION!

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #9
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/c541b7d1b734872724b2074b9f2473447ef54773.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 9! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
There are 90 artworks in the game, 3 for each level. These include concept arts, mood paintings and character designs. You unlock them by completing a level in all of its choices.

FUN FACT
There is one ending we ended up cutting from the final release. It felt like a great and funny idea at the time, but after some time we realized it was more like a huge joke than anything else, so we decided to take it out.

CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
He looks grumpy all the time, but underneath it all he’s a softy.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/a55fcba4a95a858c93e0c2860ca1a957a5a6a8d5.png

QUOTE OF THE DAY

"Know how to listen and you will profit even from those who talk badly."  -  Plutarch

SCREENSHOT
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/56124e28709986949a8967638e78f67a11fe23f8.png

notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/e7bc99b349f9422dd483bb9a09b99c46ac74cac9.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 8! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
We have a whole room dedicated to the credits, where each developer has his or her own personal statue. A good way to thank all the amazing people who worked really hard to develop the game!

FUN FACT
Between the first prototype and the launch edition we went through 10 main versions of Unity during Development, from 4.6 to 2017.2. Sometimes the changes were so drastic we had to take a few weeks to make sure everything was updated correctly to the new version. 

CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
Cyberbanana’s CEO: a man of heavy influence in the tech industry. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/eb991c6d23c1258cc67a1e60e7a9ff6de5011397.png

QUOTE OF THE DAY

"You can never know everything, and part of what you know is always wrong. A portion of wisdom lies in knowing that. A portion of courage lies in going on anyway."  -  Robert Jordan

SCREENSHOT

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 6! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
To complete the whole game, unlocking every trophy and every achievement, the average player will need approximately 10 hours. If you want, you can get through the game in about 4 hours, playing each level only once.

FUN FACT
The most difficult level to create for us, from a design point, was the tutorial. Overall we tried 5 completely different iterations before setting on the one you’ll find in the DEFINITIVE EDITION. 

CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
One of the best teacher around. Be careful not to upset her, or you’ll be in trouble!

QUOTE OF THE DAY

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 5! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
Today we are going to talk about the music in the game. The soundtrack composed by Luigi Di Guida is made of 15 tracks for a total of half an hour of music! Every experience has a unique background music, with different variations. 

FUN FACT
In a team so small, everyone has to cover more than one role. Our game director Davide tested the game a lot: he has 200 hours of playtime on steam and the game isn’t out yet!

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #4
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/db79ed4195a7b8ec513b59cae9e27ea034e6ee37.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 4! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
We’ve already talked about choices in Road to Release #1. We want to expand a little bit by talking about how choices impact the game ending. Every level is open from the beginning and replayable, but only the first choice the player take in a level will be recorded for the ending. So if you play through one level for the first time and you are dissatisfied with your choice, you can replay it any time you want, but the first choice you took is the one that’s going to influence the final ending. 

FUN FACT
Back in February 2017 The Way of Life Game Director Davide was invited by Microsoft to showcase the game at their GDC event in San Francisco. It was his first time flying. After a 16 hours flight, he swore never to set foot on a plane again.

CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
Music is her passion. She expresses angst through her guitar. Member of the Howling Dungeon heavy metal band.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/0d7107a4e770b9a86b00b7764b879a7b0b83b904.png

QUOTE OF THE DAY

"If people sat outside and looked at the stars each night, I'll bet they'd live a lot differently."  -  Bill Watterson

SCREENSHOT
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/f1239ef87eda82b523469a20907ff3b191073bab.png

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #3
notes.content:
TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #3

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/434b19b600d6b4454ea11caf551be76da3f70b92.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 3! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
Did you know that the three characters are related to each other? The Kid is the Adult’s son and the Oldman’s nephew. Even if all the experiences are open and accessible from the very beginning, all stories are in some way linked, and it is possible to trace a timeline if you play all the experiences! 

FUN FACT
During production we assigned a code name to each character, main or secondary, based on their predominant color. For example, we called the Kid “Red”, the Adult “Blue” and the Oldman is “Brown”. We did this to better organize the project and to improve visual identification of each character, so that every character would be instantly recognized based on their color.

CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
You probably shouldn’t trust this guy, even if he could help you.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/4c96b6bf9a09e1e54826c5d59dc791112792d1e0.png

QUOTE OF THE DAY
"There isn't a way things should be. There's just what happens, and what we do."  -  Terry Pratchett

SCREENSHOT
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/baa4b2986592d3401aa144327abc36348650e509.png

notes.title: TWL: DEFINITIVE EDITION - Road to Release #2
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/3cea6d931d16b2ff1bd267f525953aad91c53c45.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release, stage 2! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT
After watching the trailer, someone commented on the presence of guns in the game. Today in this feature spotlight we want to touch on that a bit. Even if the game features guns in a couple of experiences, those are just a small fraction of the whole game, and both times it is well contextualized. They are not there for the sake of it! If, after watching the trailer, you are scared of finding another game with guns… rest assured! That’s not what The Way of Life: DEFINITIVE EDITION is about!

FUN FACT
The first prototype of The Way of Life was created over the weekend of January 26th 2014 during Global Game Jam 2014. That means The Way of Life has been around for a little more than 4 years! 
 
CHARACTER SPOTLIGHT
This character is an artist and a rebel inside. He believes he can change the world with his art.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/ea3c62665a8b1921232d44b9e20057c370a2b576.png

QUOTE OF THE DAY
"Very little is needed to make a happy life; it is all within yourself, in your way of thinking" -  Marcus Aurelius


SCREENSHOT
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7486887/459cae62213dd66fa8b19273daa567be7cccbbf4.png

Hello! Welcome to The Way of life: DEFINITIVE EDITION  road to release! If you don’t know already, the game will be out on March 15th, after almost 3 years of development. We are going to post a new announcement every other day with a bunch of info, insights and curiosities about the game and its development. Follow us along until the game is released!

FEATURE SPOTLIGHT 
In the DEFINITIVE EDITION of the game, there are more than 75 choices to make! What does that mean exactly? Each level has 2 or more choices (some more obvious than others) that the player will need to face. Every choice will lead to a different ending of the level, and If you can find them all, you’ll get a nice surprise!

FUN FACT
Over the course of the development (from the very beginning of the first prototype) we created exactly 1500 commit on github. That means we “updated” the game 1500 times!

notes.title: VERSION 2.0 UPDATED!
notes.content:
Hi guys, we have finally updated the Free Edition of the game with lots of improvements and fixes.  


Here are the full patch notes for the 2.0 update released on November the 21st, 2016.



    We overhauled the tutorial section to clearly reflect all the changes we made in the new update. All in all, the tutorial should be more clear and more useful than the previous one.
    A new mechanic has been added to the game: in-game tips. Whenever you feel lost or in doubt on what to do next, by pressing a key (Q on Keyboard, B on gamepad)  you’ll receive a small tip contextualized as one of the character thoughts. This should hopefully make the game easier to understand. 
    Made a lot of improvements to the character controller: all movements should now be smoother and overall more pleasant.
    Solved a bug where the cursor would not be locked in the game screen after switching to desktop and switching back in.  
    Changed the Oldman character movement system as some people would get motion sickness. The new system should fix the issue, retaining at the same time the same simulation of the old age view. 
    Solved a game breaking bug in the Positive Dream Kid section where landing on roofs would not work properly. 
    Solved a game breaking bug in the money gathering section in the Positive Dream Adult level where collision with NPCs would send the player flying out of the game world. 
    Sped up some sections of the game which were too long and boring.
    General bugfixing and frame rate improvement.
    Major improvements to the user experience.
    All texts have been overhauled and spelling mistakes have been fixed.
 

Overall, we focused on making the game much more enjoyable by listening to all of your feedbacks. We hope you’ll enjoy the new update and the new mechanics!

As always we are listening to all of your messages and feedbacks, so if you find bugs or if you have some ideas on how you would improve the game, let us know in the comments or in reviews, we do read them all one by one.

notes.title: The Way of Life: Definitive Edition!
notes.content:
Hello friends!
As always thanks for your support! We read every single message and review and we‘re already trying to fix everything and polish the experience, taking your feedbacks and suggestion in consideration for future updates.

Something that started an year ago as a simple five minutes prototype is now increasingly shaping up to become a full fledged videogame experience.
So far, we worked on the game with our resources  with no additional funding, but we are now in need of your help. As we already mentioned before, we’re starting a crowdfunding campaign for the complete version of the game later this month. 

Huge part of the success of the game is due to the game being free. We still want the community to experience a small part of the game for free, with limited content (no achievements, no cards, only a small selection of levels to try out). Consider it as an extended demo version. 

To do this, however, we need to ask you a little help.

We opened up a new greenlight page for the The Way of Life DEFINITIVE EDITION, the true way of playing The Way of Life. You can find the link here:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=511380366

Please upvote it if you want to see the development of the game completed.

Thank you!

notes.title: NEW UPDATE LIVE!
notes.content:
Hello friends!

We are happy to announce we have released a new update, the first in what we hope to be a long list! The prototype version of the game will always be available as demo. We are working really hard to bring you our vision of The Way of Life. The game as we designed it will be way bigger than what we can currently achieve without funds or external helps, so we are going to start a crowdfunding campaign on September. After this update, the next major one will be available to you at the beginning of the campaign: we hope that you'll try out the levels and you’ll be able to decide if our game is worth your money. Obviously, there is still a long way to go, so the levels we are releasing are still to be considered as alpha, missing content like music and sound fx and technical features, like optimization, controller support, a more detailed setting menu and so on.

The quality of the final game will be of course proportional to the result of the campaign.

This new update features 3 new levels and a whole new Experience. We hope you’ll have a fun time playing the new content.

Since the game is still very early in development, we are looking forward every possible feedback.

This game wouldn’t have left his prototypal stage if it wasn’t for your overwhelming support and feedback, so once again, we would like to thank every single one of you, you guys rocks!

The Way of Life team

 Check the facebook page!
